clue.text: Absurdly quaint date, extremely old-fashioned

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.definitionFit: Something antiquated is outdated to the point of seeming ancient, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Article in temporary shelter for occupant

parts.note: a tent is a temporary shelter used when camping
an is the indefinite article in grammar

explanation.surface: An item stored in a camping tent is described as its occupant.
explanation.definitionFit: A tenant is the person who occupies a property, a near synonym of occupant.

clue.text: Powerful figures on board in New York borough

definitions.meaning: the most powerful pieces on a chessboard
One of the five boroughs of New York City

explanation.surface: Chess champions gather in a part of New York.

clue.text: Go along with a third-rate crew?

clue.text: Gloom of daughter on vessel on Scotland's deep loch

explanation.definitionFit: Darkness and gloom both mean an absence of light, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Support rear

definitions.meaning: the ... of something is its rear part

explanation.definitionFit: Back is both a verb for supporting a cause and a noun for the hind part.

clue.text: Cooked crab I ate, the source of digestive problems?

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written
taken as written

clue.text: Some replicas setter discovered in storage unit

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

clue.text: Inclination to manage English clubs in US city

clue.text: Collapsed screes in secluded place

explanation.definitionFit: A recess is a remote or hidden nook, a secluded spot.

clue.text: Crossword setters use these to baffle and bewilder, say

definitions.text: Crossword setters use these to baffle and bewilder, say

explanation.surface: Setters deliberately puzzle solvers.

explanation.definitionFit: Words of the same meaning are what setters swap for definitions; baffle and bewilder are such a pair.

clue.text: Born and died without thing essentially required

explanation.walkthrough: 'essentially' picks I, the middle of THING; 'without' removes it from DIED to leave DED.
explanation.definitionFit: Needed and required both describe something that is necessary, so they are synonyms.

clue.text: Objectives of radio mast from time to time

explanation.surface: The goals of a radio mast, occasionally.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from time to time' takes every second letter of RADIO MAST.

clue.text: Remedies powerful Italian family head cut back

clue.text: Vehicle adult parked between two others

explanation.surface: A grown-up leaves a vehicle wedged between two others.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Vehicle' and 'two others' work together: the two others are themselves vehicles, and 'parked between' places the adult's letter in the middle of them.
explanation.definitionFit: A caravan is a towed mobile home, an example of a vehicle.

clue.text: Main computer network in roof space

parts.note: an attic is the space just under a roof

explanation.definitionFit: The main is a literary term for the ocean, and the Atlantic is an ocean.

clue.text: Emotionally moved, behaving in an unnatural way

definitions.meaning: to be touched or moved emotionally
... also describes manners that are put on and artificial

clue.text: Canvassed poorly, lacking skill initially, for wage increases?

clue.text: Frees oneself from bounds of enormous cloaks

parts.note: capes are sleeveless cloaks

clue.text: Dogs receiving large decisive blows

clue.text: Coloured whirlpool cycling

parts.note: an eddy is a small whirlpool

clue.text: Production of films of upset people surrounded by spies

clue.text: Superbly courageous maltreated coheir

clue.text: Mishap as one day overwhelmed by stress
